title: Title-card cut: a rhythm table of flashes, holds and blacks, drawn as a storyboard strip
use: Plan the edit of a title-card film: which card, how many frames, which variation; the rhythm and flash rate are checked before rendering frames.

groups.note: flash groups; 0 picks the count that lands nearest the middle of the duration range

repeat.note: consecutive repeats of a card inside a group (with push-in variants)

relations: Flash groups of 3-6 cuts of 2-6 frames, each group one ground tone, bounded by holds or blacks.
Holds 12-32 frames, blacks 4-14, the whole cut 10-15 s at 30 fps.
decoration: Push-in variants z105/z110 on repeats; one click per flash cut, a low thud on holds.

provenance.corpus: Nocturne Corridor (夜想回廊) experiment: our own original fictional anime set in the shinbo style pack's grammar, first pass and reviewed final
provenance.method: Geometry taken from the final round's HTML/CSS as fractions of W and H; text sizes and colours chosen so the final passed the browser check (contrast with text hidden, ink overlap, collage alpha, off-canvas). All copy is original.
measured: final film: 13.9 s, 41 segments; flashes 2-5 frames, holds 12-32, blacks 2-10
a black of 2 frames and inverted / red flash variants inside groups alternate ground tones; the grammar keeps one ground per group so the cut stays under 3 flashes per second
